concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 require fetching data from BOTH NREL and Materials Project. Task T012a (NREL) is marked unchecked, and T012b (MP) is checked. However, T012c (Merge) depends on T012a. If T012a is not implemented, the merge task cannot execute, leaving FR-001 partially unimplemented. The task list must ensure T012a is actionable and not blocked by missing upstream logic (e.g., T008 for API keys).

FR-001 mandates fetching from both sources. T012c (Merge) is unchecked and depends on T012a (unchecked). Without a task to implement the merge logic (concatenation, deduplication), the requirement to produce a unified dataset is unmet.

FR-002 and US-1 require computing descriptors including 'perovskite_family' for stratification (FR-004). T014b (derive perovskite_family) is unchecked. T020 (Model Training) depends on T014b. Without T014b, the stratification requirement in FR-004 cannot be satisfied.

FR-002 and US-1 require handling measurement uncertainty. T013b (calculate T_d_uncertainty) is unchecked. T020 (Model Training) depends on T013b for uncertainty weighting. Without T013b, the uncertainty weighting requirement in FR-002/US-2 is unmet.
FR-003 requires grid search limited to ≤10 combinations. T022 (Implement grid search with hard cap) is unchecked. Without this task, the computational budget constraint in FR-003 is not enforced.
FR-003 and US-2 require tracking metrics (RMSE, R², MAE). T023 (Implement metric tracking) is unchecked. Without this, the success criteria in SC-001 cannot be measured.
FR-003 and US-2 require saving trained models and metrics. T025 (Save trained models) is unchecked. Without this, the model artifacts required for US-3 (SHAP analysis) are missing.
FR-005 requires extracting SHAP values. T028 (Implement SHAP extraction) is unchecked. Without this, the interpretability requirement in FR-005 is unmet.
FR-005 and Constitution VII require permutation testing with p < 0.05. T029 (Implement permutation importance) is unchecked. Without this, the statistical rigor requirement is unmet.
FR-006 requires testing on held-out literature data. T030 (Implement logic to load held-out data) is unchecked. Without this, the external validation requirement in FR-006 is unmet.
FR-006 and US-3 require OOD detection. T031 (Implement OOD detection) is unchecked. Without this, the OOD assessment requirement is unmet.
FR-006 and US-3 require reporting separate metrics for in-distribution vs. out-of-distribution. T032a is unchecked. Without this, the metric separation requirement is unmet.
FR-006 and US-3 require reporting separate metrics for external validation. T032b is unchecked. Without this, the external validation metric requirement is unmet.
FR-005 and US-3 require a ranked list of elemental properties. T033 (Generate ranked list) is unchecked. Without this, the feature importance reporting requirement is unmet.
FR-005 and US-3 require a validation report. T034 (Write validation report) is unchecked. Without this, the documentation requirement is unmet.
FR-002 and US-2 require uncertainty weighting in model training. T044 (Update model_training.py for uncertainty weighting) is unchecked. Without this, the measurement rigor requirement is unmet.
FR-002 and US-3 require documenting TGA specifications in the validation report. T045 (Update validation_report.md) is unchecked. Without this, the documentation requirement is unmet.
FR-002 and US-3 require a 'Measurement vs. Correlation' narrative. T046 (Write narrative) is unchecked. Without this, the scientific rigor requirement is unmet.

T001a (Create project directories) is unchecked. While T001b and T002 are checked, the directory structure is a prerequisite for all subsequent tasks. This should be marked as complete or explicitly blocked if the environment is assumed.

T003 (Configure linting) is unchecked. While not a functional requirement, it is part of the Setup phase. If the project assumes a pre-configured environment, this should be noted; otherwise, it blocks the 'Setup' phase completion.
T004 (Implement state_manager.py) is unchecked. This is a foundational task required for Versioning Discipline (Constitution V). Without it, the state tracking requirement is unmet.
T005 (Create descriptor.schema.yaml) is unchecked. This is required for the Single Source of Truth (Constitution IV). Without it, the schema requirement is unmet.
T008 (Setup environment configuration) is unchecked. This is required for API key management (FR-001). Without it, the data fetching tasks (T012a, T012b) cannot execute.
T041 (Update metadata.schema.yaml) is unchecked. This is required for the instrumentation metadata requirement (FR-002). Without it, the metadata validation requirement is unmet.
T015 (Implement logic to exclude entries) is unchecked. This is required for data hygiene (US-1). Without it, the exclusion requirement is unmet.
T016 (Implement VIF calculator) is unchecked. This is required for FR-008. Without it, the collinearity diagnostic requirement is unmet.
T017 (Write final processed dataset) is unchecked. This is required for US-1. Without it, the final dataset artifact is missing.
T035a (Update README.md) is unchecked. This is required for documentation. Without it, the user guide is incomplete.
T035b (Update docs/api.md) is unchecked. This is required for documentation. Without it, the API documentation is incomplete.
T036a (Refactor retry logic) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes the retry logic is already in place, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T036b (Refactor data_fetcher.py) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes the data_fetcher is already refactored, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T037a (Profile pipeline) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes profiling is done, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T037b (Optimize bottlenecks) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes optimization is done, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T038 (Additional unit tests) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes sufficient testing, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T039 (Run quickstart.md validation) is unchecked. This is a polish task. If the project assumes quickstart is valid, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.
T040 (Verify artifacts have hashes) is unchecked. This is required for Versioning Discipline. Without it, the hash verification requirement is unmet.
T027 (Integration test for OOD detection) is unchecked. This is an optional test. If the project assumes OOD testing is covered by other tests, this should be noted; otherwise, it is a missing task.

T010 (Contract test for data ingestion) is checked. This is good. However, T011 (Integration test for API retry) is also checked. These are optional tests. If the project assumes these tests are sufficient, this is fine. Otherwise, more tests might be needed.

T018 (Unit test for grid search) is checked. This is good. However, T019 (Integration test for pipeline runtime) is also checked. These are optional tests. If the project assumes these tests are sufficient, this is fine. Otherwise, more tests might be needed.

T026 (Unit test for multiple-comparison correction) is checked. This is good. However, T027 (Integration test for OOD detection) is unchecked. If the project assumes OOD testing is covered by other tests, this is fine. Otherwise, more tests might be needed.
